full_judgment:
2. Prosecution case, in brief, was that the respondent No. 1 as informant lodged an First Information Report (in short, FIR) before the Officer-in-Charge, Bawfol Police Station, District: Patuakhali against 5(five) accused persons including the present petitioner under sections 143/341/323/325/307/379/506/114 of the Penal Code alleging, inter alia, that on 20-2-2016 at 5-30 pm while his son Bayezid Adnan, nephew Shohel and Shakhawat Ullah were standing in front of the tea-stall of Selim at Tetultala. At that time, under leadership and order of accused No. 1 Khalilur Rahman (Khalil) the other accused persons started beating his son, nephew with iron rod and lathi. Accused Khalil with the intention to kill his son forcefully caught the throat of his son and tried to stop his breathing. Accused No. 2, Esa hit on the shoulder of his son with iron rod. Accused No. 3 Babu struck with iron rod on the left hand of his nephew Shohel Akon and broke the bone of the hand. Accused No. 4 Rubel Fakir hit with lathi of Gab tree on right hand of his nephew arid broke his hand. Accused No. 5 Mofizul Islam along with other accused persons started hitting on the shoulder and finger of his nephew Shakhawat Ullah and broke his finger. Accused Khalil forcefully took away Taka 47,000 from the pocket of his son. Accused Esa forcefully snatched the golden chain from throat of his son. Accused Babu forcefully snatched the Samsung galaxy mobile set from his nephew Shakhawat Ullah. Local people and witnesses of the case brought them to the Bawfol Hospital and Doctor of that Hospital referred them to Dhaka Pangu Hospital. Hence, was the FIR. 

 5. The informant as petitioner again filed Naraji petition against the final report before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Patuakhali. The learned Chief Judicial Magistrate directed the Criminal Investigation Department (in short, CID) for further investigation of the case. The investigating officer of CID after conclusion of investigation submitted supplementary charge-sheet being No.217 dated 21-8-2017 under sections 143/ 341/323/307/325/326/379/506/114 of the Penal Code against all the accused persons. 

 16. On perusal of the records it is divulged that one Md Alauddin Akon (freedom fighter) filed an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the High Court Division for quashing the judgment and order dated 13-5-2019 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate discharging 2(two) accused persons under section 241A of the Code from the charges brought against them, which was affirmed by the learned Sessions Judge, Patuakhali in Criminal Revision No. 90 of 2018 arising out of Bawfol Police Station Case No. 29 dated 21-2-2016 corresponding to GR No. 56 of 2016 under sections 143/341/323/325/326/307 /379/506 and 114 of the Penal Code, now pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Patuakhali. 

 19. The informant as petitioner again filed Naraji petition before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate who after hearing the parties accepted the naraji and directed the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) for further investigation. The investigating officer of CID after completion of further investigation sub-mitted charge-sheet under sections 143/341/ 233/307/325/326/379/506 and 114 of the Penal Code against all the accused.
